digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge surface: CLI, library, and MCP
propositions: Noun-based bridge operations (preview, sync, status, pause, resume, check_access) must be exposed through the public library with typed results and reuse the shared reconciler core disposition logic
New bridge MCP tools with explicit typed options (no mode parameter) must be registered alongside the retained legacy reconcile(mode=...) tool, both gated by mcp.allow_jira_sync for mutating routes

Legacy library rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and MCP reconcile(mode=...) must maintain their published defaults, accepted modes, return types, exceptions, and mutation boundaries as compatibility adapters without code duplication

A typed result-bearing helper must be extracted beneath run_pass() that returns _Disposition and structured pass detail before CLI collapses it to an integer, reused by library and MCP without parallel reconciler implementations
Every new MCP tool must publish an outputSchema with parity to its typed result model, and existing compatibility schemas must remain valid after registration

Mutation boundaries must be preserved: preview never silently becomes sync, read-only operations must not be rejected by mcp.allow_jira_sync, and each legacy mode must map to equivalent semantic state and mutation outcome via the shared core policy
